title: 카페에서 늦었을 때: 사과하고 사과 받기
objective: Say sorry (미안해요/죄송해요), accept an apology (괜찮아요/아니에요), and promise with -겠습니다.
summary: A friend arrives late at a café, says sorry, and is forgiven.
setting: A café, on a Saturday afternoon. Minsu is late to meet his friend Sarah.

task.title: Apologize and respond
task.line: Use the words from page 1 and the promise form -겠습니다 to finish each item.

words.meaning: I'm sorry (to friends and people your age)
words.example: 미안해요, 그 책 아직 안 읽었어요.
words.exampleMeaning: Sorry, I haven't read that book yet.

words.meaning: I'm sorry (more polite, to older people, teachers, customers)
words.exampleMeaning: I'm sorry, teacher. I didn't do my homework.

words.meaning: No worries, not at all (a soft reply to sorry)
words.exampleMeaning: No worries, I was late too.
Don't worry. We have plenty of time.

words.meaning: for sure, without fail (makes a promise strong)

dialogue.korean: 사라 씨, 정말 미안해요. 제가 늦었어요.
dialogue.meaning: Sarah, I'm really sorry. I'm late.
No worries. I got here a little while ago too.
Oh, really? It's okay. Don't worry.
Next time I'll definitely come early.

exercises: Choose the right word. ① You work at a café and speak to a customer whose coffee is late: 손님, (죄송해요 / 괜찮아요). 커피가 조금 늦었어요. ② A: 제가 우산을 잘못 가져갔어요. 미안해요. B: (아니에요 / 죄송해요). 괜찮아요.
Make a promise. Rule: verb stem + -겠습니다 (가다 → 가겠습니다). Change the verb in brackets to -겠습니다: ① 내일은 아홉 시까지 ____. (오다) ② 숙제는 오늘 밤에 ____. (하다)
Fill in the blank with one word from the word list (it means "by mistake"): 미안해요. 문자를 ____ 보냈어요.
Put the lines in the right order: (가) 네, 알겠어요. (나) 정말 미안해요. 책을 안 가져왔어요. (다) 괜찮아요. 내일 꼭 가져오세요.
Answer in Korean: You forgot to call your friend yesterday. Say sorry and promise to call today. Use 꼭 and -겠습니다.
answers: Sample answer (other answers are fine if they say sorry and use 꼭 and -겠습니다): 미안해요. 오늘 꼭 전화하겠습니다.
